Cap 30 min: phases A+B take ~16 min (a cycle waits ~70 s for the slowest of 4 floors) = 48 single-pair floor routes (12 cycles x 4 floors, every second cycle with a forced collection), then phase C runs ~14 min with 6 NPCs dancing as 3 pairs on each of 4 floors = ~56 floor-minutes of a 6-NPC crowd, ~5x hit 1 (5-6 NPCs for ~10 min on one floor), so 0 throws here is clearly more floor use than the case that threw. Per-floor cam seen/far is logged on every cycle line (off-camera floors are evidence, not a problem).
